title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・きっと、また

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is victorious against Seiun Sky at the grand event, the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, their race toward the future doesn't end here. The two runners vow to battle again as they take their respective paths.
